newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Kabila due in Kinshasa within hours - spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Kabila due in Kinshasa within hours - spokesman.

text.p: Self-proclaimed President Laurent Kabila will arrive in Zaire's capital Kinshasa within hours, a spokesman said on Tuesday, ending confusion about his travel plans.
"He is coming in the hours to come...today," Kabila's deputy information "minister" Louis Hamuli told reporters at a briefing on arrangements for the new ruler's arrival.
